tasks.name: Research SQL Standards
tasks.description: Research the current SQL standards and gather information about the different versions and their features.
tasks.prompt: Research the current SQL standards, including SQL:2011, SQL:2016, and SQL:2019. Gather information about the different versions and their features, including data types, query syntax, and database management system support.

tasks.name: Organize SQL Standards Information
tasks.description: Organize the gathered information about SQL standards into a logical structure for the book.
tasks.prompt: Organize the gathered information about SQL standards into a logical structure for the book. Create an outline that includes chapters on the history of SQL, SQL syntax, data types, query optimization, and database management system support.

tasks.name: Write SQL Standards Book Chapters
tasks.description: Write the chapters for the SQL standards book based on the organized information.
tasks.prompt: Write the chapters for the SQL standards book based on the organized information. Each chapter should include a detailed explanation of the SQL standard features, examples, and best practices. Use a clear and concise writing style and include headings, subheadings, and bullet points to make the content easy to read.

tasks.name: Review and Edit SQL Standards Book
tasks.description: Review and edit the SQL standards book for accuracy, clarity, and consistency.
tasks.prompt: Review and edit the SQL standards book for accuracy, clarity, and consistency. Check for grammar, punctuation, and spelling errors, and ensure that the content is well-organized and easy to follow.
